meta.name: wjs-segmenting-video
meta.description: Use when the user has a long-form video (interview / lecture / podcast / conversation) and a transcript SRT, and wants to extract 3–6 stand-alone topical short clips from it. This skill ONLY cuts and crops — it produces raw clips + per-clip SRTs as a hand-off package for downstream post-production (`/wjs-overlaying-video`). Triggers — "切成几段", "分主题", "拆成短视频", "切片", "topic segments", "split into clips".

copy.tagline: 从长视频中自动提取主题短片段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有长视频和字幕，想快速切出几个独立主题的短视频片段。
